scope: Small candidate instruction comparison using new independent synthetic cases and draft-only readers; lead source/operation assessment.
stop: Stop at eleven tasks; no draft repairs, case substitutions or candidate tuning after results.
candidateChange: One sentence preserving event identity within a condition, added to the existing preservation rule. No active skill change before evaluation.
acceptance: Inspect independently authored source obligations and requested edit scope for every draft. Candidate can be a useful lead only if it repairs a failure shared by both current batches, introduces no current-pass/candidate-fail case, and both draft-only reading orders pass evidence/control checks. Small sample cannot establish broad quality gain. Otherwise retain current guidance.
controls: Four lead-authored reader controls, frozen before reading; all required identities and literal draft excerpts must validate. Source/gold hidden from reader input.
limits: Fresh contexts share filesystem; instruction-only isolation.
Same model alias writes and reads. Exact backend revision, token use and costs not exposed.
Lead performs source/operation adjudication; not human-reader comprehension, personal voice, natural activation or blind style preference.
